name: Guernsey Airport

hours.v: Open 06:30–21:00 local all year (closed Christmas Day)

curfew.v: Closed 21:00–06:30 local; extensions to 23:45 only for scheduled carriers
curfew.quote: Extensions permitted until 2345L (scheduled carriers only – charges apply).

handling.v: Handling is mandatory; the two FBOs handle private flights and take GA slot requests

slots.v: Level 1; general and business aviation slot requests go to the FBOs
slots.quote: General and Business Aviation slot requests should be directed to the FBOs based at Guernsey Airport.

customs.v: Customs and immigration apply on every inbound/outbound flight; paper GAR via the FBO (not by email or fax); customs hours not stated
customs.quote: There are customs and immigration procedures if inbound to or outbound from Guernsey or Alderney Airports.
